sources.snippet: Nemotron Hinglish v6 Nemotron-Hinglish-v6 is a fine-tune of nvidia/nemotron-3.5-asr-streaming-.6b specialized for English, Hindi and Hinglish (Hindi-English code-switching), built for cache-aware streaming ASR. It continues from the v5 checkpoint (the Devanagari-latch fix is preserved) and fine-tunes further on the same blended corpus with a cosne (LR) schedule, improving overall convergence ...

sources.title: Nemotron - Wikipedia
sources.snippet: Nemotron is a family of artificial intelligence models developed by Nvidia. It includes large language models and multimodal models intended for reasoning, computer programming, information retrieval and agentic AI applications.
